# One I.T. Pro for Law Firms

law.oneitpro.com is a One I.T. Pro resource and campaign experience for law firms. One I.T. Pro is the company that operates this site.

## Law-firm resource
- [Technology for law firms](https://law.oneitpro.com/ai-law-firms.md): Audience, problems, services, geography, contact options and compliance limitations.
